thought.text: All core verifications pass. Final check — the Filament admin panel login and container stability:

reasoning_content:
Everything is working:
- API (3001) is running, authenticated requests return 200 with club data, unauthenticated ones return 401
- OpenAPI spec is served at /v1_openapi.json (200)
- Swagger UI (3002) is being served with swagger-ui assets (SWAGGER_JSON_URL env var points to http://localhost:3001/v1_openapi.json — this is resolved from the browser; in the case of docker compose, SWAGGER_JSON_URL=http://localhost:3001/v1_openapi.json works because the browser on the host accesses localhost:3001)
- Web dev (3000) is running, the login page renders with title and password field
- Web prod build (3003) is running (308 redirect to login)
- The API admin panel root redirects to /admin/login (Filament login)

Also, I'll confirm that the Filament admin panel login page (http://localhost:3001/admin/login) is 200, and confirm that all containers are stable. After that, final check: container status.

Another verification: that the admin login page (3001/admin/login) returns 200.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'filament login: %{http_code}\\n' -L http://localhost:3001/admin/login; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\\t{{.Status}}'", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check Filament login and container status"}
